data.one_liner: Official Reicon icons for Dart & Flutter with 2700+ SVG icons in Outline and Filled weights.
data.what_it_does: Provides access to over 2,700 handcrafted, pixel-perfect SVG icons in Outline and Filled weights. Allows developers to get SVG path data, build complete SVG strings, and look up icons dynamically by name at runtime.
use_when: You need a comprehensive icon set with both Outline and Filled weights.
You want to render scalable vector icons using SVG path data in Flutter.
avoid_when: You prefer using standard pre-packaged Flutter IconData widgets without handling SVG strings.
You require an icon library that is already deeply integrated into Material or Cupertino widget sets.
strengths: Contains over 2,700 handcrafted icons drawn on a strict 24x24 grid.
Includes both Outline and Filled weights.
Zero dependencies, working across all platforms in pure Dart.
weaknesses: Requires integration with an SVG renderer like flutter_svg to display icons directly in Flutter widgets.
Does not provide standard IconData classes out of the box.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and optionally use with flutter_svg for rendering.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer icon fonts over raw SVG path strings.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the Lucide icon style and standard Flutter icon usage.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want official Material Design symbols.
